label: none
cause: With no history, or a history of an old root, a certificate from a private root that the clients trust has the facts of an interception at a remote hop. The trust is private at the target and public at the reference. With the history of the root, the baseline stage tells the two apart.
end: A probe of the logs of Certificate Transparency (ND-23): a name with public certificates in the logs and a private root at the check is an interception.
